column4: Opening paragraph: library and every generated matcher promise; 'It is the contract'.
Design docs are 'informational background, never a second source of authority'.
'where one disagrees with this document, this document is what pcrec promises'.
'The mirror is partial.' with the per-field mirror column in the section 6 table (1136-1168).
find-all loop calls <prefix>_next_pos (429-430); section 3.1.1 (508) specifies it. Both facts stated.

New: loop agrees with re.finditer on 22 of the 26 pairs in tests/encseam/findall_cases.txt, the other 4 lossy strict-subset (475-487). Verified file: 22 exact + 4 lossy = 26. Both engines/captures arms stated; '52 runs' total not stated.

Stated at 2477-2484 (a{9795} compiles, a{9796} refused, wording names --engine=vm which works). CAVEAT live probe: refusal only under --engine=dfa; default auto prints a note and falls back to VM for a{9796}, so new text omits the engine condition (pre-existing inaccuracy).
PCREC_ENC_BYTE (0) is the spelling (2612, 2435); -e ascii is an unknown encoding (2615). The rename from ASCII is history (not in new doc).
Statement about the old doc's own caveat text (how an earlier revision handled it); process/revision history, not a current-behaviour fact. The loop advancing via next_pos is mapped under C1-0005.
Sorted by name via strcmp; libpcre2 PCRE2_INFO_NAMETABLE order, probe_named_groups.c, D59 (1030-1036).
Sorted (name asc, number asc, strcmp) at 1030; bsearch-ability at 1045-1046 ('bsearch groups[0..nnames) by name').
slot -1 when build delivers none; captures-on '{ "b", 1, 1, NULL }' vs --no-captures '{ "b", 1, -1, NULL }' (1024-1029).
'for the primary pattern's own groups slot == number is permanent (D61...)' (695); also 1181-1183.
695 limits permanence to the primary's own groups and sends delivering rows to 5.4/5.5; 1188-1189 says rx_group_entry.slot stays the indirection for any other numbering. Same fact.
'ngroups is a PERMANENT PREFIX-LENGTH promise (D61)'; slots 1..ngroups are the pattern's own groups (1181-1183).
'Slots above ngroups belong to insertion and composition mechanisms, which APPEND and never interleave with or renumber the prefix' (1184-1187).
Shared block carries every macro whose VALUE is a pcrec-contract fact, unprefixed (84-90).
PCREC_ERR_* named in the shared block (87); 'No per-prefix spelling of any of them exists' (90); constants at 167-171.
PCREC_ERR_FLOOR (-5) at 171 and 785. The -4 -> -5 move is history, not stated.
PCREC_ERR_INTERNAL (-6) in the shared block, 'NOT a give-up' (173, 786, 827).
PCREC_UNSET ((ptrdiff_t)-1) in the shared block (178, 87-88); no per-prefix spelling (90).
Nine bit constants PCREC_VM_RUNG_*/STRAT_*/PRUNE_* in the shared block (88-90, 208-216).
'No per-prefix spelling of any of them exists' (90); the word 'alias' is not used but the fact (spelling gone) is the same.
PCREC_ENGINE_DFA 1 / PCREC_ENGINE_VM 2 (205-206); rx_info.engine row (1144) names them.

'What stays per-prefix is exactly what varies per artifact: <PREFIX>_NCAPS, the stamp macros (including the three masks), and the budget, capacity and sizing macros' (91-92); covers VM_PREFILTER/PRUNE_CEILING as stamp macros.
Entry table row for the three _in entries (275); 'Every artifact exports all three' (2830); inert on DFA (2901-2906).
Five sizing macros in the header on every artifact, four rx_info fields, <prefix>_buffers (2873-2906); inert on DFA (2901-2906).

New: <prefix>_search frame is 3,184 B (tiered), internal deep function 131,216 B, _in 144 B (974-986). Probe (-O2 -fstack-usage, ^(a(?1)?b)$ --features all): rx_search 3184, rx_search_deep 131216, rx_search_in 144. Old 'search frame 131,216' predates tiering.
'matches up to a 684-byte subject and returns PCREC_ERR_FRAMES at a 686-byte one' (2797-2800).
Table row 800 KB: match, 0.057 s, 90 MB RSS (2948).
Old text said abi 27 (stale revision note). New: 'It is 71 on every artifact' (1281; 1138; guard 99-103). Probe: emitted '(abi 71)' and '.abi = 71'.
'Where the numbers live' paragraph names docs/spec/limits.md for the numeric defaults of budgets/capacities (868-874).
(?:foo|bar)\z stamps RX_DFA_SCAN "unanchored" and RX_DFA_PREFILTER "byte-class-bounded" (763-765). Probe (--no-captures --features assertions): confirmed, RX_ENGINE dfa.
'#if'ing on RX_ENGINE is safe on every artifact' (1379-1380); RX_ENGINE in the inventory as scope all (1409).

<PREFIX>_TUNE is a 'closed five-token string' on scope 'all' (1412, 2309). Probe: one '#define RX_TUNE "balanced"' line in the pre-#include prologue. NOT stated: 'one line in the shared prologue' placement and the 23-28 byte size (abi-27 bump delta, not a contract fact); placement is in tuning.md 5.3 (4225-4226).

'At the default "balanced" nothing else differs from a build with no --tune flag' (2310-2311). Verified src/core/tune.c:34-35,79 (balanced row all sentinel, deny mask empty); the structural reason is not in new doc.

New line 2309 points tuning.md 5.3 at the stamp. tuning.md:4235-4241 (no rx_info mirror/flags), 4183 and 4327-4330 (answer-preserving, answer identity across all five positions). 'May move far more than the stamp' and 'no struct offset moves' are not stated in match_api.md; weak pointer.
Abi-25 bump description (clang -Wc23-extensions label fix); emitted label punctuation is not caller-observable. Still true: probe emits 'rx_forward_scan_views:;' at c1a.c:234. Not stated in new doc.
PCREC_ERR_STARTPOS (-7) in the shared block (174, 787); boundary guard 9.2 (2635).
9.5: every position the ENGINE generates (candidate starts, retry, first attempt at 0) is a character start; guard 9.2 for entries. ENG_ATTEMPT is not named.
_VM_CLS_FOLDS (2062-2069) describes the ASCII-FOLD shape and cites tuning.md 2.22.
<PREFIX>_VM_ENTRY_SHAPE and _VM_PROGRAM_BYTES on every VM artifact (1439, 2019-2046).

New 2029-2036 tabulates shared (forwarding entries) and forward (bodies in the _in entries, three forwards) and points tuning.md 2.21 (2021). The 'static empty descriptor' is only in tuning.md:1993-1994,2012. Probe (--vm-entry-shape=2/3, frameless VM): rx_search forwards to rx_search_in via 'static const rx_buffers rx_no_buffers' at both rungs.

New 1651-1655 names tuning.md 2.18 for the scan edge. tuning.md:1593-1635 states the entry test 'is_stop && !is_dead' and precondition (8) ('a machine whose prefilter reseeds may decline an edge'). Not in match_api.md.
Composed artifact: groups[] sorted (caller-scope first, name, number); nentries - nnames = site-scoped rows (1108-1118, 1036-1037). Non-composed unaffected (1057-1058).
VM_ALT_ISLANDS: trie dispatch over literal alternatives instead of the serial resume chain (2048-2056).
VM_FRAMELESS: 1 makes the entry-chain statics eligible for always_inline (2005-2013); DFA_UNIFORM_FOLDS (1634-1644).
DFA_START stamp and rx_info.search_form (1675-1692, 1162).

Old 'byte is the only encoding implemented' is stale. New 9.1: byte (0) and utf8 (1) both compile; other values refused (2612-2616). Probe: build/pcrec -e utf8 --pattern 'a.b' rc=0; -e ascii: unknown encoding (want byte, utf8).
Section 3.6 'Whole-subject and end-anchored matching: the (?:P)\z idiom' (737-766).
'There is no end-anchored entry'; caller compiles (?:P)\z (739-742).
'\z, not $': (?:foo)$ matches "foo\n" at [0,3) while (?:foo)\z does not (747-751).
'Testing length == n on the ordinary anchored entry ... sufficient but not necessary' (752-753).
a|ab anchored over "ab" reports [0,1); (?:a|ab)\z reports [0,2) (754-757).
'The idiom is permanent (D77, plan row [OS-4])... no end-anchored generation axis is built' (743-745).

Stated at 763-765, BUT part is now false in new doc and old: probe shows '(?:foo)\z' stamps RX_DFA_PREFILTER "run-pinned-bounded" (RX_REQ_WHY "dominated"); "memchr-bounded" only under -fno-run-prefilter. '(?:foo|bar)\z' byte-class-bounded is correct. Needs a spec fix at 764-765.
Normative rule at 555-556: from pos + 1 advance past every byte in 0x80-0xBF, stopping at the first byte outside or at n.
'Under utf8 the advance is defined on every input, well-formed or not' (551); ill-formed degrades to the next non-continuation byte (558-561).
'Every symbol a pattern compile can produce falls into one of three groups' (41); groups at 44, 57, 74.
Exception clause: PCREC_FEATURE_SET / _MODULES are PCREC_*-named yet PER-ARTIFACT, declared nowhere in lib/pcrec.h (62-69).
Per-artifact symbols scoped by pcrec_options.prefix (default "rx") (44-45).
<prefix>_search listed (45).
<prefix>_match listed (45-46).
<prefix>_match_caps listed (46).
data symbol <prefix>_info listed (48).
<prefix>_next_pos listed (47); section 3.1.1.
<prefix>_valid_upto listed (47); section 3.1.2.
'<PREFIX>_* macro family (<PREFIX>_NCAPS, the sizing macros, the stamp macros of 6.3)' (50-51).
'A pattern compiled with -p foo gets foo_search, FOO_NCAPS, and so on' (51-52). 'verified by reading the emitted header' is not restated.
'The CLI spells the option -p only; there is no --prefix long form (pcrec --prefix foo ... is an unknown-option error)' (52-53). Probe: --prefix gives "unknown option '--prefix'".
'No per-prefix spelling of any of them exists' (90) for the PCREC_ERR_*/PCREC_UNSET constants; RX_UNSET/RX_ERR_* names themselves not mentioned.
Library surface: PCREC_* enum and bit constants and pcrec_options/pcrec_output/pcrec_error/pcrec_err_input types in lib/pcrec.h (57-59).
'These are never scoped by a pattern's prefix' (59-60).
PCREC_* names only pcrec's enum/bit constants with one exception, FEATURE_SET/_MODULES, per-artifact and not in lib/pcrec.h (62-69) -- same reader takeaway.
Every artifact carries PCREC_FEATURE_SET, e.g. "std1" (64-65); stamp section 6.3.11 (2304).
PCREC_FEATURE_MODULES, e.g. "classes,modifiers" (65-66, 2304-2306).
'PCREC_*-named, PER-ARTIFACT, and declared nowhere in lib/pcrec.h' (66-68).
62-64: PCREC_* names only enum/bit constants 'with one exception' (the two stamps). Same fact, not worded as 'section 8 naming rule'.
Shared ABI block: 'scoped by neither of the above' (73-75).

New: SEVEN types in order rx_var, rx_ctx, rx_matchfn, rx_callout_ref, rx_renderfn, rx_group_entry, struct rx_info (75-77, block 129-203). Probe: emitted header declares struct rx_var first (t2.h:14). Old list of six predates module vars.
'They are spelled rx_* regardless of the prefix' (77-78).
'so that two differently-prefixed matchers compose in one translation unit (one matcher links directly as another's callout, with no adapter)' (77-80).
Types live inside their own PCREC_RX_ABI_H guard, separate from the per-prefix PCREC_GEN_<PREFIX>_H guard (80-82).
Composition in one TU stated (77-79); the guard mechanics (80-82, 106-107) give the no-collision reason.
'-p rx and -p foo builds of one pattern emit byte-identical blocks' (82).
'The guard's value is the abi' (95); #define PCREC_RX_ABI_H 71 (103). The K80 / abi 54 label is only in 107-110 ('older than abi 54').

#error text quoted at 100: "pcrec: this artifact (abi 71) shares a translation unit with an artifact of a different abi; regenerate both with one pcrec".
'artifacts of one abi share the first block' (106).
'an artifact of another abi (whose types may differ) fails to compile, naming the cause' (106-108).
One guard whose VALUE is the abi (95-104). The rationale (two keyed guards would let both blocks through and fail on a struct redefinition) is not stated.

'an artifact older than 54 included AFTER a newer one is not refused, because its own #ifndef predates the rule' (109-110).

Describes the DD-14 wave A change event (RECURSE joined, FLOOR -4 -> -5). Current values stated at 170-171 and 784-785; the move itself is history.
PCREC_ERR_INTERNAL (-6), below PCREC_ERR_FLOOR, 'NOT a give-up' (173, 786).
STARTPOS/UNSET_VAR/UTF defined in the block (174-176) and tabulated as below-the-floor refusals (787-789).
PCREC_UNSET in the block (178, 87-88).
PCREC_ENGINE_DFA / _VM in the block (205-206, 88).

rx_ctx.pos size_t 'where to match, anchored' (144).

rx_ctx.user void *, 'per-binding user data' (148).
rx_matchfn return space in the block comment (154-164) and 225-229.
'one per way the engine can give up (PCREC_ERR_STEPS/_FRAMES/_WORK/_RECURSE)' (155-156).
D49: 'those codes PROPAGATE, they are not collapsed to -1, and a caller doing an exact == -1 test sees them as distinct values' (156-158; 715-722).
'Values strictly BELOW PCREC_ERR_FLOOR stay RESERVED for a future abort semantic' (158-160); 820-825.

'a generated call site that invokes an rx_matchfn traps on one' (162-163); 850-866 adds the PCREC_ERR_UTF exception.

Not stated: that rx_info's ncaps field comment names <PREFIX>_NCAPS. TRUE today (t2.h:86 '== this artifact's own <PREFIX>_NCAPS'); the new doc's ncaps row (1141) states ncaps == <PREFIX>_NCAPS and calls emitted member comments non-authoritative glosses (1129-1130), so low-value.
<PREFIX>_NCAPS stays per-prefix because it varies per artifact (91-92); 890-891 ('a property of the ARTIFACT').

'no bare rx_info type exists' (252-253); extern const struct rx_info <prefix>_info at 220.

'under the default prefix the per-artifact instance <prefix>_info is the identifier rx_info, which a typedef of the same name could not coexist with' (252-254). Separate struct-tag namespace is implied, not spelled out.

Section 10 'Working storage: the _in entries and the tiered default' (2778-2830); inventory row 275 points to 10.

're-runs the same match from scratch on the full stamped default, by calling a non-inlined internal function that owns that storage' (2994-2996).
'No answer changes' paragraph (3010-3019) and 'Every promise of 3, 4 and 5 stands unchanged' (3023).
'The depth an artifact can reach is unchanged ... only the cost of not reaching it moved' (3026-3028).

entry frame 98,512 -> 3,168 B (gcc -fstack-usage) (3040-3041).
'(The ^(a(?1)?b)$ specimen of 5.3 and limits.md 5 is a different artifact with different numbers: 131,216 -> 3,184 B.)' (3041-3042).

'1.24-1.53x slower above it' (3051).
